units.source_text: 我和大家一起登上客店的二楼，把行李卸下来。

en.t: I went up to the second floor of the inn with the others and set down my luggage.

units.source_text: 榻榻米和隔扇又旧又脏。

en.t: The tatami mats and sliding screens were old and dirty.
The dancer brought tea up from downstairs.

units.source_text: 她刚在我的面前跪坐下来，脸就臊红了，

en.t: No sooner had she knelt down in front of me than her face flushed with embarrassment,

units.source_text: 手不停地颤抖，茶碗险些从茶碟上掉下来，

en.t: her hands kept trembling, and the teacup nearly slipped off the saucer,

units.source_text: 于是她就势把它放在榻榻米上。

en.t: so she quickly set it down on the tatami mat.

units.source_text: 茶碗虽没落下，茶却洒了一地。

en.t: Although the teacup did not fall, the tea spilled all over the floor.

units.source_text: 看见她那副羞涩柔媚的表情，我都惊呆了。

en.t: Seeing that shy and tenderly charming expression of hers, I was utterly stunned.
